commentary: Foundational Avicennian principle of emanation: the First Cause (absolutely simple) can produce only one effect directlyâ€”the first intelligence. Multiplicity would imply complexity in cause. This emanationism structures the hierarchical cosmos and undergirds astrological and magical models by establishing chain of being from One to many.

scholar_citations.quotation: the chain of being from One to many structures the occult worldview Pico inherits.
scholar_citations.work: The Arabic Influences on Early Modern Occult Philosophy (2015)

latin_incipit: Ab uno simplici in fine simplicitatis non provenit nisi unum.
charge: Some argued that God's absolute power should allow creation of multiplicity directly.
defense: Avicenna's principle preserves divine simplicity while accounting for cosmic multiplicity through hierarchical emanation. Essential to understanding how the One structures through multiple intelligences and spheres.

english_translation.text: From one that is simple in the highest degree, only one can proceed.

exegesis: Pico's conclusion on Essence/Existence within the Avicennism (Islamic Philosophy) tradition.
